'''B'wek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She served at [[Titan Base]], an Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].<ref name="OSG" />
